WITH goldsboro_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Goldsboro' AND border_type = 'city'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(ST_Slope(r.rast, 1))::numeric, 2) AS avg_slope_degrees
FROM
  public.dem_us,
  goldsboro_geom g
WHERE
  ST_Intersects(dem_us.rast, g.geom)
  AND dem_us.rast IS NOT NULL;
